events.title: Eagle Point, Hyder, AK
events.thought: End of day forty-four. Crossed into Alaska — barely.

events.title: Glacier Viewpoint Camp
events.thought: The Salmon Glacier viewpoint draws its people — camped here with a collection of wanderers.
events.photoCaption: Overland rigs, campers and expedition vehicles parked for the night at the Salmon Glacier viewpoint at dusk.

events.title: Shrimp Tacos, Hyder, AK
events.thought: Shrimp tacos in Hyder — civilization appears in unexpected places.
events.photoCaption: Shrimp tacos served on a cedar board in Hyder, AK — a surprisingly excellent restaurant at the end of the road.
